s0.ru: Опций {n}, запись — действие и сколько тактов его держать: {listing}. Опции идут по порядку, действие не меняется, пока его такты не кончатся. Какое действие на такте {k}? Нумерация тактов с 1.
s0.en: There are {n} options, each entry an action and how many ticks to hold it: {listing}. Options run in order, and the action stays until its ticks are done. Which action is on tick {k}? Tick numbering starts at 1.

s1.en: There are {n} options, each entry an action and how many ticks to hold it: {listing}. Options run in order, and the action stays until its ticks are done. How many ticks does the whole record take?
